shop.demo.menu.intro: * Welcome to the&  demo shop.&* Take a look around.
shop.demo.talk.0.name: About the shop
shop.demo.talk.0: * This is a demo shop.&* Stock, locks, sellout —&  all wired in.&* Shop system by Kite95.
shop.demo.talk.0.b: * Oh — that ribbon?&* It's on the shelf now.&* You asked, so it's yours&  to buy.
shop.demo.talk.1.name: What else?
shop.demo.talk.1: * Written UTE-style.&* Of course, credit to&  the great AI.
shop.demo.talk.1.b: * Host events only.&* With 1+ kills, this&  shop turns geno.&* If it doesn't, I forgot&  to change the check.
shop.demo.talk.2.name: About UTE
shop.demo.talk.2: * UTE's history goes back to 2018.{sleep 20}&* Back then, TML started&  developing UTE to make a game&  for a friend's AU called&  Inheritale.{pause}{clear}* Later, that project somehow&  was cancelled. After adding the&  overworld system, UTE finally&  saw the light of day in 2019.&  You probably know the rest.
shop.demo.talk.3.name: Trivia
shop.demo.talk.3: * The settings and shop room&  have existed since UTE's&  earliest versions, but nobody&  ever filled them in.{pause}{clear}* Well, at least this template&  got made. Not the most&  powerful, but it gets the&  basics done.
shop.demo.talk.4.name: Notes
shop.demo.talk.4: * The shop system uses the&  save system to store dialogue&  progress and inventory data.&  You can check the save file&  to see the details.{pause}{clear}* Hand-writing shop saves is&  too tedious, but the trade-off&  is some limits on resource naming.{pause}{clear}* For example, shop host objects&  must start with shop_host_,&  and so on.
shop.demo.talk.5.name: Pages?
shop.demo.talk.5: * That's right, this shop&  system supports pagination.{sleep 20}&* I mean, who runs a shop&  with only four items and&  four lines of dialogue?
